# Astro Dodge

A top‑down space‑flight game rendered on an HTML canvas. The player pilots a ship through an endless stream of moving asteroids, steering with arrow keys (or WASD) and optionally firing lasers. Asteroids drift in random directions and speeds.

**Lose condition:** The game ends when the ship collides with any asteroid or runs out of fuel.
